chunks: "Every animal subjected to nahr but slaughtered as dhabh is haram, and every animal subjected to dhabh but slaughtered as nahr is haram."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.حَرَامٌ: religiously unlawful and impermissible to consume
key_terms.مَذْبُوحٍ: an animal slaughtered by dhabh, cutting at the neck
key_terms.مَنْحُورٍ: an animal slaughtered by nahr, piercing at the throat hollow

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if an animal is slaughtered using the wrong prescribed method?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the valid method of slaughter for different animals. It states that using the wrong slaughtering method renders the animal haram, highlighting the importance of observing the prescribed rules of halal slaughter in fiqh.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3080 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Every camel slaughtered in the manner of Dhabh (slaughtering at the neck) is unlawful, and every other animal slaughtered in the manner of Nahr (piercing at the throat hollow) is unlawful."
